title: Identify existing file systems on a device
summary: Use lsblk to see which file systems are present on your drives and partitions, including their type, label, and mount point.

aliases.text: what filesystem is on my drive
what filesystem is on my disk

steps.explain: List block devices with file system information.

alternatives.explain: Run lsblk with the filesystem flag to show the FSTYPE and MOUNTPOINT columns for each device.
alternatives.expect: A list of devices with columns for FSTYPE (e.g., ext4, swap) and MOUNTPOINT (e.g., /, /home).

verify.expect: Output shows NAME, FSTYPE, LABEL, UUID, and MOUNTPOINT columns.
